question: Who among the following continues to be hailed as the empress of Bharatanatyam across the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tanjore Balasaraswati.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tanjore Balasaraswati:-**

 
 
• She​** **is considered one of the **greatest Bharatanatyam **dancers of all time.
 
• She was born in **1918 in Tamil Nadu **and began her training in Bharatanatyam at a young age.
 
• **Balasaraswati** was known for her **grace, fluidity, and emotive performances**, and was a major force in popularizing Bharatanatyam both in India and abroad.
 
• Some of her most famous works include the dance dramas **"Sakuntalai" and "Kannappa Nayanar." **
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**:-
 
 
• It is a classical Indian dance form that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is one of eight Indian classical dance forms recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• It expresses South Indian religious themes and spiritual ideas, particularly of Shaivism and in general of Hinduism.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shovana Narayan:-**

 
 
• Shovana Narayan is a renowned Indian Kathak dancer, choreographer, and teacher.
 
• She is the founder and director of the Asavari Institute of Kathak in New Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai:-**
 
 
• Mallika Sarabhai is an Indian dancer, actress, social activist, and writer.
 
• She is accomplished in Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam dance.
 
• She was awarded the "French Palme d'Or", the highest civilian award by the French government in 1977.
 
 
 
• **Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma:-**
 
 
• **​**Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma was a pioneering Mohiniyattam dancer from Kerala, India.
 
• She began her dance training at the age of 8 under the tutelage of her father, Kalamandalam Krishnan Nair.
 
• She later studied with Guru Kunchukuttan Thampuran, one of the leading exponents of Mohiniyattam.
